name: Arnob
title: Creative Designer & Hardware Innovator
bio: I am Arnob, a creative individual with a passion for designing, prototyping electronics, and managing dynamic projects. I bridge the gap between creative visions and technical realities.
aboutText1: With a strong background in creative designs and a love for building things, I actively explore fields like hardware prototyping, product coordination, and front-end interface design.
aboutText2: As an innovator from a non-CS background, I value simplicity, user-friendliness, and clear communication. I thrive on collaborating with technical experts to construct robust solutions that solve real-world problems.
